items.name: The Bahamas Cube Challenge 2026
items.information:
The first WCA competition in the Bahamas! 

#### This competition will serve as the 2026 Bahamas National Championship. The fastest Bahamian competitor in the 3x3 event will be crowned the National Champion of the Bahamas.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. The competition is open to all competitors of all ages and nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/).
